map.按直径、髓质指数（髓质宽/毛干宽）、髓质形态（人毛窄<1/3、连续差）、鳞片排列: Identify by diameter, medullary index (medulla width / shaft width), medullary morphology (narrow in human hair, under one third, poor continuity) and scale arrangement (imbricated or irregular in human hair). Animal hair usually has a medulla wider than one half and smooth scales.
map.毛发直径 80 μm、髓质窄（髓质指数<0.33）、鳞片人字形叠瓦状 → 人毛，: A hair of 80 μm diameter with a narrow medulla (medullary index under 0.33) and chevron-shaped imbricate scales indicates human hair taken from the scalp; another of 120 μm diameter with a medulla wider than 0.5 and smooth scales indicates animal hair, excluding a human source and supporting contamination with animal hair.
map.一根毛发能个体识别吗？: Can a single hair achieve individual identification?
map.不能。形态只能定种属与部位，个体识别需 mtDNA/核 DNA 分型；毛干无根时: No. Morphology can only determine species and body region; individual identification requires mtDNA or nuclear DNA profiling. A hair shaft without a root has little nuclear DNA, so mitochondrial DNA is commonly used.
map.漂白/染发影响鉴别吗？: Does bleaching or dyeing affect identification?
map.会改变色素与表面，但髓质形态与鳞片结构稳定，仍可鉴别；受损（断端、化学处理）需结: It alters pigment and the surface, but medullary morphology and scale structure stay stable and remain identifiable. Damaged hair (broken ends, chemical treatment) must be judged together with cross-section features.
